description: Publisher access policy for a private CRID, run with the qURL CLI on this machine. Configure the next policy version, send or resend an email invitation, list invitations or consumer grants, approve or deny a consumer grant by its decision id, approve a credential with id new, or revoke access. Invite takes only action, resource_id and email; omit expected_version, approval and policy. Report the exact invited email addresses without shortening them, and resource_url from publish_crid when available. Check every page of list_invitations before claiming nobody else was invited. If listing is denied, report the send receipts and say the list is unconfirmed; do not resend. Accepted delivery does not prove enrollment. Read the current version from a listing first; configure takes expected_version (the current version) and policy.version = expected_version + 1, and the first policy on an existing private resource uses expected_version 0. For approve, put expected_version inside approval. For an existing request, use its listed decision id and version; omit all credential fields. Use id new and credential fields only for a key opt-in, never to replace a pending email request. A six-digit code alone never authorizes approval on a resource with consumer_access. Ask which listed request the user wants to approve (the verified email for review); keys needs the intended public credential and contract needs a trusted entitlement receipt. Wait for that instruction. Contract approval requires a trusted publisher entitlement receipt and expiry, not an unverified payment claim. A removal is complete only when session_cleanup is complete; repeat the same removal and version while it is pending. Email proves mailbox control, not legal identity. Legacy access requests without consumer_access that come with a six-digit code are handled by manage_crid_requests, not here.

expected_version.description: Current listed version for configure, resend, revoke_invitation, deny or revoke_grant. Omit on invites and listings; approve uses approval.expected_version.

resource_id.description: The CRID of the resource to manage access for. Copy it exactly; never trim or change case.

name: manage_crid_access
title: Manage private CRID access
